summary: Cycle 6: Deep analysis of 2 sorry sites (ordered spread). Key findings: (1) spread_below is invariant but spread_above is NOT, so invariant_formula_constant alone cannot give directed spread; (2) truth_pres for Until forward is genuinely unprovable by structural induction alone (counterexample: phi true at s' <= t in class(a) and at s outside class(a) above t, but no phi above t in class(a)); (3) Reynolds Lemma 11 density (pp.127-128) is the correct approach: class elementary equivalence + transition argument with Prior-S at gap boundary. Implementation requires ~60-100 lines. Handoff with full proof structure written.

continuation_context.key_insight: The ordered spread requires Reynolds Lemma 11 density. The proof uses: (a) class elementary equivalence to transfer 'B holds for a while at the end' across all classes, (b) construct C = temporal equiv of 'exists neg_B before me in my class', (c) show C true near right gap + false near start of next class, (d) Prior-S at a next-class point gives last C below it, but succ of that last point also has C, contradiction. The critical formula is spread_below (which IS invariant) modified with neg_B instead of phi. The counterexample for direct structural-induction proof: phi=atom_p, true at s' and s but nowhere in class(a) above t, is consistent with all hypotheses.
